title: Reclocking
description: Makes the world time synchronized with the real one!
body:
Synchronizes time between Minecraft and the real world.
You can configure the timezone used for the conversion in `plugins/Reclocking/config.yml`. **📦 Dependencies**
> ⛔ none **🪶 Features**
currently nothing much, just the timezone configuration key.
i created this plugin so it's lightweight and *just works.*
soon there will be more features for you to configure :D
**❓ Usage**
there's no specific usage for this plugin - use it where it fits.
for example, when it's night, and you don't want to hurt your eyes;
this might help xD
